_meta.description: Advisory site hints for the planner (Task 8). DATA, not code: adding a site means editing this file, never a playbook. Hints are human-readable descriptions ONLY — no CSS selectors, class names, data-testids, or data-tab values are allowed (the loader rejects them). A hint never overrides the live accessibility tree: if a hint names an element the tree does not have, the plan is invalid. Hints are off entirely when PRIVAGENT_SITE_HINTS=false.

hints: This is a retail site: a search box labelled 'Search', search-result links with product titles, and prices on the product page.
Type the product query into the search box with clear and submit, then open the matching product link to read its price and specifications.
A login or newsletter overlay can be dismissed with the Close button on the dialog.

hints: Travel search pages here have labelled fields for origin, destination, and dates, and result cards showing times and prices.
Fill the labelled fields from the user's request, submit, and verify result cards are visible before concluding.
Use dates exactly as the user gave them — never change the year.
google.com.name: Google (search and travel)

hints: This is a coding-practice site. Signing in is a human step: wait for the operator instead of typing credentials.
After sign-in, the profile page shows solved counts by difficulty and contest rating. Report numbers only as shown on the page; if a rating is absent, say it is unrated instead of inventing a number.
leetcode.com.name: LeetCode (coding practice)

hints: This is a messaging app: a chat list on one side, a conversation pane on the other.
A button named 'Groups' above the chat list filters the list to group chats; click it when the user asked for a group.
The search box is a textbox whose accessible name mentions searching or starting a new chat. Typing a contact name there and submitting opens the first matching chat.
The message composer is a textbox whose accessible name mentions typing a message. Typing with submit sends the message immediately — do not type it twice.
If the page shows a QR code, the user is not logged in: wait for the human instead of acting.
If a previous search filter is still active, clear it (a button whose name mentions cancelling the search) before picking a chat.
web.whatsapp.com.name: WhatsApp Web (messaging)

hints: This is a video site: search results are links with video titles.
A button named 'Skip Ad' may appear during an ad — click it to skip.
Typing a query into the search box is not completion: submit the search and wait for results before concluding.
youtube.com.name: YouTube (video)
